{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes shared argument parsing and startup validation in src/common/args.cpp, src/common/args.h, and src/init.cpp",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Resolves multiple hazardous behaviors caused by negated configuration flags across the node. The argument parser previously substituted \"0\" for negated options, causing crashes like an assertion in TxGraph on -nolimitclustercount, security footguns like -norpcpassword setting password \"0\" rather than using cookie authentication, -notorcontrol connecting to 0.0.0.0:9051, and -noblocksdir writing blocks to the working directory."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits to src/node/mempool_args.cpp are mechanical adaptations to argument parsing logic and do not touch policy or mempool data structures",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "The change adjusts command-line limit parsing at startup to prevent invalid negation but does not change mempool policy, acceptance, or eviction behavior."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touch to src/bitcoin-cli.cpp merely updates boolean flag evaluation and does not affect the RPC interface or server",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Modifications to argument parsing for RPC flags and bitcoin-cli do not change RPC methods, data formats, or server interface behavior."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches to wallet initialization files follow from generic argument parsing adjustments for directory paths",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Changes to -walletdir validation in wallet init and load files are downstream of generic option-parsing fixes and do not touch wallet logic or database handling."
    }
  ],

  }
